notes.title: Devlog #4 – What’s New in Corner Shop: Nightshift
notes.content: [h1]Watch the video![/h1][previewyoutube="oH3WBJbh3DI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’ve got a lot of exciting updates we’ve been working on recently:[/p][p]🎰 [b]Casino[/b] – the much-anticipated feature is finally here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6f1f5c749ddc40f30b330e66b57dabf6caa036a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💊 [b]Medicine & Coffee[/b] – now you can restore your [i]mental health[/i] with medicine, and when the night shift starts to drain your energy, a hot cup of coffee will keep you going.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/d1192b383c067030885406a95bce91e058cff383.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧽 [b]Store Cleanliness[/b] – we’ve reworked the dirt & stain system. The cleaner your shop, the better tips you’ll receive from customers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/e948e920f9820bda65d1388cbcfce4befe92303c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] 🛍️ [b]Bagging System[/b] – based on your feedback, we’ve added an extra step: now you’ll need to hand customers a shopping bag at the checkout.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6a7ac5310ff7498daf834ad6d97077a6c2f9b799.jpg"][/img][/p][p] 📦 [b]Parcels[/b] – customers can now come in with pick-up slips. It’s your job to hand out the correct package and verify the tracking number.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/c43c0b71510154d5a3bc83d442d1bfdea52714e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And this is just part of what’s coming – we’re continuing to make the night shift more immersive (and unpredictable 😉).[/p][p]Let us know in the comments what you think of these new systems and which one you’re most excited about![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/29032e3fa78e4dbbef3556e94c52666fb3c65e8b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update & Devlog #3
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
First of all — huge thanks to everyone who played the [i]Corner Shop: NightShift[/i] demo and sent in feedback. We’ve been reading it all, and many of the changes in this patch come directly from your suggestions. [/p][previewyoutube="eRZc2R9Z18I;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]📦 UPDATE – Version 0.7.15.47[/h2][h3]🧩 Gameplay & Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]Refactored quest system and whiteboard — quests now switch language instantly without delay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New mechanic:[/b] some NPCs may arrive with [b]invalid ID photos[/b] — the player can detect and react accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC age randomization to better match their appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted player movement speed in specific areas for balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction logic and fixed hidden dirt cleaning issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trash objects not colliding with the mop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]visual indicators[/b] for blocked phone apps.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue system improvements — new dialogue options added.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined horror sequences and scripted events for better clarity and timing.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 UI & UX[/h3][list][*][p]Pause menu improvements, including resolution scale setting at game start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse sensitivity setting[/b] added for improved comfort.[/p][/*][*][p]Better widget focus handling and keyboard navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed calendar format for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved notepad and navigation widgets.[/p][/*][*][p]Bank app UI rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual indicators for blocked apps in the phone UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues and added missing translations.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated phone and flashlight textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed language change behavior in quests and menus.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔊 Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Improved audio attenuation for products and store speakers.[/p][/*][*][p]Added concurrency limit for UI sounds to avoid clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed voice-over timing in horror sequences.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced loading screen music volume.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 Visuals & Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized textures for better performance (resolution adjustments where appropriate).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted field of view during certain sequences for better immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting and shadow casting in multiple areas.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📓 DEVLOG #3 – What’s Next?[/h2][p]We’ve seen your feedback about the horror layer of the game — and we agree: it can go further.
We’re working on new ways to unsettle you, blending psychological tension with physical threats.[/p][p]Here’s an early look at something in development:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/0230319967ce6e3e4510855eaa623309a89f2651.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This entity moves through ceiling vents, its tangled, cable-like form weaving in and out of shadows.
Is it just a schizophrenic hallucination of our protagonist’s fractured mind?
Or is it a real creature, hunting you from above?
We’re not saying — you’ll have to discover that yourself.[/p][p]This is [b]not[/b] in the current demo — it’s part of ongoing development inspired by your feedback. Expect more creatures, more psychological twists, and more moments where you won’t be sure what’s real.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 Let us know what you think of the update in the comments.
📌 Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game to get notified about future updates and the full release![/p]

notes.title: We’d Love Your Feedback – Tell Us About Your Night Shift
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played the Corner Shop: NightShift demo during the PlayWay Publisher Sale! We've been blown away by your interest, streams, and first impressions.[/p][p]Now that many of you have had a chance to spend a night behind the counter… we’d love to hear how it went.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What kind of feedback helps us most?[/b][/p][p]Whether you:[/p][list][*][p]Noticed a bug or technical issue[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Had a cool gameplay suggestion[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Got creeped out by something and want to share the moment[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Or simply want to tell us what you liked (or didn’t)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Where to share your thoughts[/b][/p][p]You can leave your feedback in:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]The Steam Community Forum: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3306990/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3306990/discussions/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Our Discord server Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/nAwUAmSB"]https://discord.gg/nAwUAmSB[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][p]Your input is helping us polish the game and prioritize future features.[/p][p][/p][p]And yes — we’re already working on new content based on what players are asking for.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t played the demo yet — it’s still available:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853600/Corner_Shop_Nightshift_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this early phase. Your shift’s not over yet.[/p][p]
[/p][p]— The Live Motion Games Team[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Corner Shop: NightShift – Demo available July 24!
notes.content:
[h3]Corner Shop: NightShift – Demo Coming July 24th! 🌙[/h3][p]Get ready for your first night shift.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/f2deac14525e3a2a3b3ca18cdf6048c87fd71d5c.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]demo for [i]Corner Shop: NightShift[/i] will launch on July 24th[/b]! This is your chance to dive into a psychological horror experience that blurs the line between reality and nightmare.[/p][p]🔦 [b]Step into the shoes of Adam Callahan[/b], a man trying to rebuild his life after personal tragedy by taking a night job at a small convenience store.[/p][p]🕯️ [b]The demo offers about 1 hour of gameplay[/b], covering the [b]first 3 in-game days[/b]. It’s a taste of what’s to come – introducing the game’s mechanics, atmosphere, and the story’s unsettling undertones...[/p][h3]What to expect:[/h3][list][*][p]A dark and eerie late-night atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]Flashbacks from Adam’s past, including his trip to Japan[/p][/*][*][p]A blend of store management and psychological horror mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Early choices that shape relationships and future story paths[/p][/*][/list][p] We’d love to hear your thoughts – your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the game.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 [b]Mark your calendar: July 24, 2025 – The demo will be free to play on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist and prepare for your first shift...[/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306990/#add_to_wishlist_area" style="button"]ADD TO WISHLIST[/url]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306990/#add_to_wishlist_area"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Corner Shop: NightShift – demo coming late July
notes.content:
[h1]Corner Shop: NightShift – demo coming late July[/h1][p]We're excited to announce that the [b]Corner Shop: NightShift demo will launch on Steam in late July[/b]. This early build introduces key elements from the upcoming Early Access version, offering a playable first look into the game's tone, systems, and story.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][/h2][h2]Screenshots from the demo:[/h2][p][b]SCREENSHOT 1 

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/42916bada22f8db4cd3392837a64ebe8fc2e4fbf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[SCREENSHOT 2][/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/02a2f7a27669ff98db84c7e536ad238f3a9afc13.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[SCREENSHOT 3][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/62bc3f9799148ea50b94eaef93f3abc0c39d010e.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]What's in the demo?[/h2][list][*][p]Introduction to [b]Adam Callahan's story[/b] – a man trying to rebuild his life after a personal collapse.[/p][/*][*][p]A slow-burn, immersive [b]psychological horror atmosphere[/b], set during night shifts in a lonely corner store.[/p][/*][*][p]Early versions of the [b]store mechanics[/b], interaction systems, and the in-game [b]phone and SMS features[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]A focus on [b]narrative tension[/b], subtle unease, and gradually unlocking layers of gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo will be [b]permanently available[/b] and regularly updated based on player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Frequent devlogs incoming[/h2][p]Leading up to the demo release, we’ll be publishing [b]regular devlogs[/b] where we’ll dive deeper into the game's mechanics, inspirations, design choices, and behind-the-scenes development.
If you're curious how we mix mundane routines with psychological dread – stay tuned.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Localization[/h2][p]The demo will be available in [b]16 languages[/b], with full [b]English voice-over[/b].
If wishlist numbers grow, we plan to expand voice-over support to more languages.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Media release[/h2][p]Alongside the demo, we’ll be releasing:[/p][list][*][p]A brand new official trailer[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh in-game screenshots[/p][/*][*][p]Updated gameplay footage[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Share your feedback[/h2][p]Join our [b]Discord[/b] to chat with the team and other players. Your feedback directly impacts development:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qFtTy6Uh"]https://discord.gg/qFtTy6Uh[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You can also share your thoughts on the Steam Community forum – we read everything.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Add to your wishlist[/h2][p]Wishlists help small dev teams more than you might think.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/082e25890dc9e7c287e51083d71cb78feb515dc2.gif"][/img][/h2]
